annotations.text: Editorial Ledger — Top tabs, hairline dividers instead of boxed cards, large serif figures for money throughout. Quiet, newspaper-like; the most restrained of the three.
Structured Grid — Icon rail sidebar replaces top tabs, sharp 8px corners, dense tabular data. Feels like an instrument panel; most systematic and information-dense.
Soft Depth — Pill tab bar, layered shadows, big radii, gradient hero card. Warmest and most consumer-app; costs the most visual weight of the three.

Bloomberg-Meets-Luxury-Banking — a ticker strip, gold hairlines on black, serif headline numerals paired with monospace data. Densest and most opinionated of the four; reads like a private wealth terminal.
